recognize_zh: 抹片中大型巨噬細胞胞質呈淡藍色泡沫／網狀空泡（foamy），切片中泡沫狀組織球大片取代造血組織，CD68 強陽性；此即假性尼曼匹克細胞（pseudo–Niemann-Pick cells），與高三酸甘油脂血症相關。
features: Aspirate: large macrophages with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated (foamy, soap-bubble) cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
Foamy macrophages form clusters admixed with hematopoietic cells
Core biopsy: extensive interstitial replacement by pale, vacuolated histiocytes with reduced hematopoiesis
Special stain panel shows pale foamy cells with little staining of the cytoplasm
CD68 immunostain diffusely positive, highlighting sheets of histiocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show numerous large macrophages with abundant, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. The core biopsy shows extensive infiltration of the marrow space by sheets of foamy histiocytes with a corresponding reduction in hematopoietic elements. The histiocytes are strongly and diffusely positive for CD68. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden pseudo–Niemann-Pick cells; in the setting of pancytopenia and marked hypertriglyceridemia this represents a secondary lipid storage phenomenon, and a primary lysosomal storage disorder should be excluded by enzyme or genetic testing.

ddx.vs: True Niemann-Pick cells are morphologically similar and are separated by acid sphingomyelinase activity or SMPD1/NPC gene testing rather than morphology.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue-paper' cytoplasm rather than round bubbly vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain rather than clear foamy vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial or fungal infection with foamy histiocytes
ddx.vs: Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms demonstrable by AFB, GMS or PAS stains and are often associated with granulomas.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; special stain; IHC: CD68
